#!/bin/bash
# collect SRC DEST: move every *.txt regular file directly inside SRC into DEST.
#  - only non-hidden names ending in lowercase ".txt"; directories are skipped
#  - names may contain spaces, glob characters, or start with a dash
#  - DEST/INDEX accumulates every name collect has ever moved into DEST:
#    one name per line, sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C sort), no duplicates
#  - prints "moved N", N = number of files moved by this run
src="$1"
dest="$2"
mkdir -p -- "$dest"
count=0
shopt -s nullglob
shopt -u dotglob nocaseglob
for path in "$src"/*.txt; do
  [ -f "$path" ] || continue
  f=${path##*/}
  mv -- "$path" "$dest"/
  printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$dest/INDEX"
  count=$((count + 1))
done
if [ -f "$dest/INDEX" ]; then
  LC_ALL=C sort -u -o "$dest/INDEX" -- "$dest/INDEX"
fi
echo "moved $count"
